sections: Atomic layer deposition of MoO x thin films using Mo( i PrCp) 2 H 2 and O 3
Atomic layer deposition of MoOx thin films using Mo( i PrCp)2H2 and O3

figures.caption: FIG. 1. Saturation curves for ozone (3 wt. %) and bis-isopropylcyclopentyldienyl molybdenum dihydride. Sample growth temperatures were set to 150 °C. Pulsing sequences are (a) Mo( i PrCp)2H2 + 20 s purge + 40 s O3 + 20 s purge and (b) 6 × 0.25 s Mo( i PrCp)2H2 + 20 s purge + O 3 + 20 s purge.

FIG. 2. Growth per cycle of MoOx and SUP for various growth temperatures using the pulsing sequence of 6 × 0.25 s Mo( i PrCp)2 H2 + purge + 40 s O3 + purge. Purge time was varied with deposition temperature.
FIG. 3. X-ray diffraction pattern for as-deposited and annealed MoOx growth with the Mo(iPrCp)2H2 precursor for 2 Θ = 24° -28°. The annealed sample was heated to 350 °C in air for 20 min.
FIG. 4. Mo 3d core-level XPS spectra for XPS ALD MoOx deposited using Mo ( i PrCp)2H2 at 100, 150, and 200 °C and a 200 °C deposited film annealed at 350 °C for 20 min.
FIG. 5. O 1s core-level XPS data for ALD MoOx deposited using Mo( i PrCp)2H2 at 100, 150, and 200 °C and a 200 °C deposited film annealed at 350 °C for 20 min.
FIG. 6. Ex situ FTIR data of as-deposited and annealed MoOx film using Mo ( i PrCp)2H2 and Mo(NtBu)2(NMe2)2 from (a) 4000 -1100 and (b) 1100 -500 cm -1 .
